description:
Build strength. Keep it simple.

Lean Muscle Club brings guided workouts and everyday habits together. Available in Simplified Chinese and English.

MOVE WITH A PLAN
Choose from 14 built-in routines for home, gym, and mobility. Follow exercise cues, mark each set, and use rest timers to keep your session moving.

SEE THE MOVEMENT
Watch animated exercise demonstrations. Pause a demo, slow it down, or view a representative pose. With Reduce Motion enabled, demonstrations use a still pose. Animation speed does not set your workout pace.

KEEP DAILY HABITS VISIBLE
Log your water intake and sleep duration. Review today's check-ins alongside your training activity.

FOLLOW YOUR OWN PROGRESS
Record weight and waist measurements and review your recent activity. Focus on your own consistency rather than comparing bodies.

OPTIONAL APPLE HEALTH
With your permission, view sleep, weight, and waist measurements from Apple Health alongside your manual records. You can also choose to save finished workouts, weight, and waist entries to Apple Health. The app does not upload these HealthKit samples.

CHECK IN AT A GLANCE
Choose to show whether today's workout, water, and sleep have been logged on widgets and a paired Apple Watch. This optional sharing is off by default. It excludes detailed measurements, HealthKit samples, and account information.

LOCAL-FIRST TRACKING
Core logging and training work without an account. Training and body records are stored on your device. You can export your records when you choose. Whether system backups include app data depends on iOS and your device settings.

Exercise content provides general fitness information, not medical advice or an individualized training prescription. Choose movements and intensity that suit your circumstances. Stop if you experience pain or feel unwell.
promotionalText: Build a routine that fits your day. Follow guided workouts, track water and sleep, and review your progress in one simple, local-first app.
whatsNew: You can now choose to save finished workouts, weight, and waist entries to Apple Health. When you turn this off, you choose whether to keep or delete the data that Lean Muscle Club saved.
